Standalone code passed 15 non-asymptotic quadrature checks and symmetrical bounds; finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: It is a physically motivated environmental inference limit for correlated Brownian gases: even an infinite number of simultaneously observed noninteracting particles fails to determine the current switching state, despite independent thermal noise, and the sharp explicit 1/N excess quantifies the only available incremental improvement. This unifies exact hidden-environment mixing, thermal sensor averaging, and optimal binary decision loss; the finite-N benchmark is usable for population-sensing design. The basic beta prior and generic Bayes methods alone are not claimed novel.
